PLACE YOUR VIDEOS HERE
======================

The website is wired to these two placeholder videos. Drop your real files
into this folder with these exact names and the site will pick them up
automatically (no code changes needed):

  1. hero-video.mp4      -> Big full-screen background video on the homepage
                            (top hero slider). Landscape, ~10-20 seconds,
                            MP4 (H.264) recommended so it plays on all browsers.

  2. venture-video.mp4   -> Video showcased in the "video-box" section on the
                            homepage. Landscape MP4, any length.

Poster images are shown until you upload the actual videos
(poster set in the code: /img/extra/video-poster.jpg).

Keep them reasonably sized (< 15 MB each) so the site loads fast.
